DB Query with Retry
  Executes SQL queries with automatic retry logic and prepared statements support.
  Input:
 - msg.topic: SQL query string (use ? for placeholders)
 - msg.params: Array of parameters for prepared statements (optional)
  Output:
 - msg.payload: Formatted response (success or error)
 - msg.statusCode: HTTP status code (200 or 503)
  Features:
 - Up to 3 retry attempts on failure
 - 1 second delay between retries
 - Prepared statements support (SQL injection safe)
 - Consistent JSON response format
 - Automatic error handling
  Example usage:
 msg.topic = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?";
 msg.params = [userId];

Flow to adjust parameters
info:
ES
Este flujo ajusta parametros de simulacion (camaras, probabilidades, ritmo) desde varios injects, los guarda en flow, construye un payload con defaults si falta algun valor y lo envia por HTTP POST a /admin/update, mostrando el payload y la respuesta en debug.

EN 
This flow updates simulation parameters (cameras, probabilities, pacing) via inject nodes, stores them in flow, builds a payload with defaults when a value is missing, and sends it by HTTP POST to /admin/update, showing both the payload and the response in the debug panel.

name: This flow represent how to manage the alerts
info:
ES
Este flujo recibe alertas por POST /alerts, parsea el JSON y enruta por tipo. Si es ITV y está caducada o próxima, construye y envía un email y un aviso por Telegram; si es POLICE, envía un aviso por Telegram. El resto de alertas se muestran en debug.

EN 
This flow receives alerts via POST /alerts, parses the JSON, and routes by type. If it is ITV and expired or near expiry, it builds and sends an email and a Telegram notice; if it is POLICE, it sends a Telegram alert. Any other alerts are shown in debug.
